title: Best Vacuums: Robot, Cordless & Pet Hair (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by cross‑referencing the top‑rated models listed in Consumer Reports, Good Housekeeping, TechGearLab, and BHG. Products that appeared in more than one source were prioritized.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide them.

verdict.line: Picture a family that cleans every day and needs a powerful, versatile vacuum. The Shark Stratos Upright delivers strong suction on carpets and bare floors, has a large dustbin, and is easy to use. Its main catch is that it is heavier than stick models.
